import asyncio, gc, json, tracemalloc
from dataclasses import replace
from statistics import median
from my_llm import MyLLM
from tests.helpers.protocols import PROTOCOLS
from tests.performance.fingerprint import source
from tests.performance.workloads import Size, build, controls, profiles
async def main():
    result = {"source_sha256":source(),"definition":"Separate warm tracemalloc probes; fixture construction and cache seeding excluded; three probes after gc.collect; peak Python allocations, not RSS.","cases":[]}
    for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
        size = replace(Size(),rounds=24,tools=4,parallel_calls=2,text_chars=256,argument_items=3)
        workload = build(protocol,protocol,size,native=True)
        provider,model=profiles(protocol)
        for mode in ("uncached","incremental","repeat"):
            cached = mode != "uncached"
            async with MyLLM(provider=provider,model=model,stdio_protocol=protocol,enable_message_cache=cached) as llm:
                async def prepare(messages):
                    return await llm.codec.prepare({"messages":messages,"tools":workload.tools,"stream":True,**controls(protocol)},llm.resolved_profile,input_format=protocol,client=llm.client_parameters,enable_message_cache=cached,message_cache_key=llm._message_cache_key)
                async def seed():
                    if cached:
                        llm.codec.expire_message_cache(llm._message_cache_key)
                        await prepare(workload.messages[:-1])
                        if mode=="repeat":
                            await prepare(workload.messages[-1:])
                values=workload.messages[-1:] if cached else workload.messages
                await seed()
                await prepare(values)
                samples=[]
                for _ in range(3):
                    await seed()
                    gc.collect()
                    tracemalloc.start()
                    try:
                        prepared=await prepare(values)
                        current,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()
                    finally:
                        tracemalloc.stop()
                    samples.append({"current_bytes":current,"peak_bytes":peak})
                    del prepared
            result["cases"].append({"upstream":protocol,"mode":mode,"peak_median_bytes":median(v["peak_bytes"] for v in samples),"samples":samples})
    print(json.dumps(result))
asyncio.run(main())
